title: Which country will win the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup?
background: The 2026 men's FIFA World Cup will be co-hosted by the United States, Canada and Mexico.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : FIFA's official final match result and announcement of the tournament champion. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the country whose national team wins the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup final, scheduled for July 19, 2026. A victory after extra time or a penalty shootout counts as winning the final. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The country's common English name.
